description: Checked the slip and kept ink off the plot.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Held the cuckoo for Monday and taught no new note.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Counted four days and ended the accounting.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept Berowne, believed the empty sleeve, and sent the other look home.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked for the sleeve, accepted that he had not been shown a sheet, and stayed in his old place.
name: Will Kemp

description: Showed an empty sleeve and left the new page upstairs.
name: William Shakespeare
